svg.text: Drawn in the worst case: the write touches the first W replicas, the read the last R. If those two touch, every pair touches —

text.font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Noto Sans Symbols 2', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Apple Symbols', Verdana, sans-serif

svg.text: so the condition is exactly W + R > N.
